title: Aspiring writer-director here. I’ve got a question.

commenti.body: Can you stop posting this shit every single day? If you took even half of the time you spend coming up with new throwaway accounts and spamming the same question all over Reddit and spent it working on your script instead, you'd be finished by now. I would not want to watch any of these movies and if I ever see a film with a description that even closely resembles one of your ideas I will tell everyone I have ever met to avoid it out of spite.
